verdict.rationale: Firebase ships a built-in assistant, Gemini in Firebase. It offers a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console and can generate code, schemas, queries and mutations on demand. It can also analyze Crashlytics crashes, logs and messaging campaigns, so users can hand it analysis and generation tasks. However, the evidence shows it advising and generating, not executing multi-step tasks inside the project. The MCP server is an external-client feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that the assistant takes actions or executes delegated tasks autonomously in the project, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: generate code for faster development, and shorten your troubleshooting process with new insights from Gemini in Firebase using a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console
Use Gemini in Firebase to generate schemas, queries, and mutations on-demand using natural language.
Gemini in Firebase can decipher error messages and provide clear explanations and mitigations. It can also analyze logs
